title: Beyond Chains of Thought: Benchmarking Latent-Space Reasoning Abilities in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark measures latent-space reasoning abilities across eight distinct categories: arithmetic, causal, logical, moral, social, spatial, temporal, and linguistic reasoning.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a focus of the research.
